card.name: Second digit inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit that follows the first digit of a two- or three-digit number, often a 0 or 5, in dose, rate, or count figures. It fires just before a unit such as mg, mcg, seconds, or cases.

modes.label: Dose numbers
modes.description: Trailing digit of a multi-digit dose figure before a unit like mg or mcg.
modes.example: PEDIATRICS Kidney Transplant 60<<0>> mg/m 2 orally twice daily,

modes.label: Recipe times
modes.description: Trailing digit of a time in seconds in cooking directions.
